history: fresh: the public repository starts from this curated snapshot; no private history is carried over
excluded_trees: private development records, agent instructions and development tools (not published)
mechanical_changes: versions: 0.1.0 for the first public snapshot, 0.1.1 for this release (workspace, pyproject and the four workspace crates in Cargo.lock)
licence metadata (MIT; MIT AND BSD-3-Clause for dss-vortex, dss-py and the wheel), authors, repository and homepage

comments, docstrings and documentation: references to unpublished development records, review notes, scripts and private test files replaced by references to docs/format, committed tests and fixtures, or by the fact stated inline
tests: host-specific default paths removed; tests that need unpublished files read them only when an environment variable names them
tests: a few helper files and recorded outputs that the public tests use were moved into crates/*/tests (support/ and data/)
fixtures: two reference text files had their header text reworded; their SHA-256 pins in the tests and fixtures/public/README.md were updated
dss-wasm: recorded route digests re-recorded after error-message text changed (all counts unchanged)
NOTICE and the wheel licence bundle: project name ras-commander-fast-dss and upstream notices reproduced verbatim
new public files: LICENSE, README, CHANGELOG, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, licenses/, docs/releasing.md, workflows, source manifest and scripts
workflows: wheels for Windows x86_64 and manylinux/musllinux x86_64 and aarch64; no macOS builds
